decision: ADR-004; Temporal remains a candidate, not selected
interpretation: Passing observation tests include unsafe raw behavior; not 26 passed Cardea acceptance requirements.

environment.server: Temporal development server 1.32.0; embedded SQLite, not production
environment.transport: ephemeral loopback gRPC listener; no existing service

limitations: Development server only; no production PostgreSQL or Debian run
No authenticated Cardea broker, supervisor/ancestor enforcement, or real host confinement
No simultaneous signal registration race or retention test
No cross-store commit integration, schema upgrade/restore or verifier integration
No dependency vulnerability audit or operating-cost benchmark
Default thread cancellation tested at a waiting Python barrier; interruption-disabled mode uses an explicit SDK option
